description: Postpone the Argent update reminder, on every tool-server on this machine, when the user wants it later or tomorrow, wants it stopped, or never wants it (87600 hours). Installs nothing. A memory or a reminder of your own does not change it. Returns { message, remindersResumeAt, persisted, pendingVersion }: tell the user when reminders resume, and if persisted is false, that it did not fully hold.

hours.description: Hours until reminders resume: 168 is a week, 87600 is the longest, 0 turns them back on. Minimum: 0.

name: dismiss-update
